Investment objective

Rosebud Holdings Property Income REIT offers to provide Investors the opportunity to access a diversified portfolio of Euro commercial real estate through a closed-ended fund.

The Company seeks to provide investors with an attractive level of income, coupled with the prospect of income and capital growth, through investing in commercial property.
